description: Données maillées représentant l'intensité de l'artificialisation du trait de côte à l'échelle métropolitaine (grille 1' par 1') - Carpediem 02/08/2018 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut français de recherche pour l'exploitation de la mer (IFREMER). Data produced as part of the Carpediem project led by the French Agency for Biodiversity with the scientific and technical support of UMR Amure (AFB-UBO convention reference AAMP/16 007). Source data: CEREMA. The objective of the Carpediem project is to produce synthetic maps of anthropogenic pressures and their likely or potential effects on marine ecosystems. Coverage: Institut français de recherche pour l'exploitation de la mer (IFREMER). The portal shows the English title as "Mesh data representing the intensity of artificialization of the coastline on a metropolitan scale (grid 1' by 1') - Car" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut français de recherche pour l'exploitation de la mer (IFREMER). Its keywords include ouvrage, metropole-golfe-de-gascogne, amenagement, digue, epis, artificialisation. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WWW:LINK, WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
